protocol.role: development mechanism diagnosis using consumed real and planning seeds
protocol.source_roster: 54 frozen K26 trajectories: three loads x three real seeds x three planning seeds x raw/mixed source policies
protocol.shadow_comparison: before each active native call, copy all planning RNG states and run the opposite selector offline; native trajectory RNG and counters remain unchanged
protocol.current_candidates: raw and mixed must retain identical root search, support incumbent, analytic challenger, planning path and random-draw endpoint
protocol.state_roster: every source frame, including drain, where the same pre-call sample selects physically different actions; service, duration and sorted per-class completion offsets define physical equality
protocol.intervention: replay the identical native prefix; force raw versus mixed first action once; both branches then use memoized frozen v4 K26 until the identical original population drains
protocol.sign: all intervention and oriented planning deltas are mixed-first minus raw-first, in job-seconds
protocol.area_partition: current and future use each branch's own first-frame boundary; current plus future and flow components must reconstruct total

repeated_sampling.selectors: run raw and mixed from separately initialized identical states for every sample
repeated_sampling.measure: fixed challenger-minus-incumbent margins, within-state means/variances/MCSE and paired mixed-minus-raw change
repeated_sampling.reuse: one paired estimate per unique load/queue and contender pair; reused across occurrences

protocol.residual_partition: actual minus discovery estimate equals fresh mean minus discovery sample plus actual minus fresh proxy mean, separately for raw and mixed
protocol.diagnostic_work: native source accounting, shadow selector work and RNG copies, continuation-cache searches, replay frames, and both fresh-sampling selectors are reported separately from online K
protocol.source_snapshot: full text companion file; no hashes
protocol.stopping_rule: all 54 sources and every physical disagreement once, then 64 paired fresh samples for every unique state; no outcome filter, tuning or extra seeds

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: Disagreement states are selected by the two development policies. Fresh samples estimate only these fixed contender pairs and do not remove that conditioning.
Actual-minus-proxy residuals combine finite arrival-tape noise, horizon cutoff and two-step/fluid versus v4 continuation; they are not pure model-bias estimates.
Sources share development tapes and cases have overlapping futures. Counts and means are descriptive, correlated and cannot be summed into a whole-policy gain.
The common-v4 intervention isolates one action from subsequent mixed-policy feedback; independent confirmation remains required before adoption.
